items.subject: Updates to your branded content toolkit on YouTube
items.summary: YouTube rolled out branded content toolkit updates for disclosing partnerships.
items.body:
Supporting your brand partnerships on YouTube

We've introduced several features that streamline how you disclose paid content. These updates include refreshed viewer-facing labels for branded content, as well as age and location controls. We're also starting to roll out automated detection for undeclared brand deals and may start auto-labeling content we detect as paid promotion that wasn't declared.

As a creator, you are responsible for ensuring your branded content is properly disclosed and follows our policies and all legal regulatory requirements.

What's in your branded content toolkit?
Clarified global policy
Redesigned viewer labels
Age and location controls
Automated detection
